title: Green Fig and Saltfish
description: Green Fig and Saltfish is a dish from Saint Lucia featuring salt cod, banana, yellow onion, tomato. This home-sized recipe records each ingredient at the step where it is used. Use firm unripe bananas, not ripe dessert bananas, for green fig and saltfish.

steps.instruction: Soak salt cod in cold water in the refrigerator for about 24 hours, changing the water several times. Drain before simmering; never soak salted fish at room temperature.
Gently cook the prepared contents in the simmering liquid from earlier steps until fully cooked and safe to eat.
Cook the listed ingredients in simmering water for about 24 minutes until tender; drain well if necessary.
Chop the vegetables as needed. Sauté the listed ingredients over medium heat, stirring, for about 11 minutes until softened and aromatic.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
